title: Endovascular Repair of Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (EVAR)
description: Medicare coverage guidelines for endovascular abdominal aortic aneurysm repair (EVAR). Requires infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm measuring >= 5.5 cm in men or >= 5.0 cm in women, or rapid expansion rate > 0.5 cm in 6 months, with suitable landing zone anatomy on CT angiography.

criteria.name: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Diameter (>= 5.5 cm in Men / >= 5.0 cm in Women)
criteria.description: Computed tomography angiography (CTA) confirming maximum transverse infrarenal AAA diameter >= 5.5 cm (men) or >= 5.0 cm (women), or expansion > 0.5 cm in 6 months.
criteria.clinical_intent: Threshold diameter for rupture risk exceeding elective intervention risk
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Suitable Proximal Neck Landing Zone Anatomy
criteria.description: CTA confirming proximal infrarenal aortic neck length >= 10 mm and diameter <= 32 mm without severe circumferential thrombus or > 60 degree angulation.
criteria.clinical_intent: Verify anatomical seal feasibility for stent graft
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

criteria.name: Small Stable Aneurysm (< 5.0 cm) Exclusion
criteria.description: Elective repair of small stable asymptomatic aneurysm < 5.0 cm in diameter with expansion < 0.5 cm per year.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude sub-threshold aneurysms better managed with ultrasound surveillance
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act § 1862(a)(1)(A) excludes items and services which are not reasonable and necessary for the diagnosis or treatment of illness or injury or to improve the functioning of a malformed body member.

cms_reference.notes: No active NCD or LCD exists in MCD. Previously cited L35091 was Cataract Extraction. Covered under inpatient Part A surgical benefit.
